title: Constructing a rich window
statement: Let $Q,T$ be types with decidable equality, let $k$ be a natural number, and choose work-tape indices $\mathrm{src},\mathrm{dst}$ and an embedding $\iota:\{0,1,2\}\hookrightarrow\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$, with neither chosen index in the image of $\iota$. Let $\mathrm{ws}$ be a Boolean word and $s$ a natural number whose value is the binary value of $\mathrm{ws}$ read least-significant bit first. Suppose a configuration $d$ starts in the copy phase, tape $\mathrm{src}$ contains the buffered word $\mathrm{ws}$ at offsets $-1$ through $|\mathrm{ws}|$ (encoded as digit symbols), and all tapes indexed by $\iota$ are blank. Then there is a time $t\le 26(s+|\mathrm{ws}|)+48$ at which the machine reaches its final phase for the first time. At that time, tape $\mathrm{dst}$ contains $s$ zeros, then a one, then $s$ zeros, each encoded as a cell symbol with blank content, on the $2s+1$ cells beginning at its original head position; all other cells and configuration data are unchanged. Up to time $t$, every work-tape head stays within distance $2s+|\mathrm{ws}|+3$ of its initial position.
